en.hubeali:
Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding two witnesses testifying upon a woman that her husband has divorced her. So she re-married. Then her husband came and denied the divorce.

Heasws said: ‘They would both be whipped the legal penalty (Hadd), and would both be responsible for the dowry to the husband. Then she would observe the waiting period, then return to her first husband’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid who has narrated the following: “About the case of two witnesses who testify for a woman that her husband has divorced her and she marries; but her husband comes and denies the divorce, he (the Imam) has said, ‘
The two must be subjected to penalty and held responsible for the mahr (dower) in favor of the husband; then she is returned to the first husband.’”
